subtitle: Lesson 3 · Post-Incident Activity

eyebrow: Step one: the base query — too broad
code:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "schtasks.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "/create"
caption: Real and runnable, but IT admins and software create scheduled tasks constantly — too noisy on its own.

eyebrow: Step two: the actual root cause, as a filter
code:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "schtasks.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "/create"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
    "\\AppData\\", "\\Temp\\", "\\Users\\Public\\")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine
caption: The attacker's task launched from AppData — legitimate software almost never does. That's the precise signal.
